title: Voice Lint and Voice Studio: readiness
statusText: 2026-09-12: public website live; source 7360a67, static artifact 12fabf4; Studio remains local preview
summary: Source 7360a67 is published on agent-orc/voice-lint main. Verified static release 12fabf4ec02d504ce7502d2c8b7eb40e1fe19d71 is published on deploy in the same repository. Strict validation without --allow-dirty passed 99 files, 24 routes plus the redirect and 87 input hashes; the artifact contains no Studio application or backend. Merge 12e8bdb preserves the existing Voice Lint history and seven exported Devspace product commits through f19c7dc. All new Voice source commits belong to this standalone repository; static website artifacts belong to deploy. Both managed local apps run from C:/Projects/voice-lint. All six project IDs and browser enrollment were preserved, five internal roots were moved, and 55 session assertions plus 18 real Chrome session checks passed. Final local website verification passed 96 views and 322 links, assets and fragments; Research passed 16 checks for 30 sources and writing patterns passed 22 checks. The old active local Devspace copy is removed, its unpublished commits and 24,623 remaining files are preserved, and the published Devspace tree and history remain unchanged. Unrelated status, index entries and submodule HEADs were preserved; no Devspace commit or push was made. The user approved the central-repository exception. Central commit eeee6eff3d2cd7b6a6ddfbfe14f8a9c0d7b5e339 publishes the four-file ecosystem integration. https://agent-orchestrator.dev/voice/ is live: 99 exact artifact files, 24 HTML routes, MIME types, the 308 redirect, missing/private-route 404s and the English/German ecosystem link passed HTTPS verification. Existing hosted sites retain their public HTML. The retained release record identifies source, artifact and check time. Voice Studio remains a supervised local preview with guarded original-source review and adjacent resizable panes. Earlier evidence retains 120 layout checks and 106 backend assertions. The two libraries separate writing knowledge and host-driven tools from HTML visualization. Public pages expose no LLM capability. Reproducible offline quality evaluation is implemented; no model-quality run or measured winner exists. The registry restart issue is fixed: exactly two identical built-in duplicates were removed privately, all six original IDs and data remain, and both API and file contain six unique projects after restart. Absolute-root canonicalization passed 146 backend assertions including 40 regressions. The loading overlay keeps content mounted and places status on the content area, separate from toolbar, review and splitters; 120 split-layout checks passed again. The focused delayed-GET browser check passed 178 assertions across six live layouts, source, Markdown and initial document/report loading, without project or model writes.
